method: Recomputed each durable Fred request fingerprint from its stored visible history, retained assistant reasoning, scope and every canonical effort candidate; exact unique match. No messages or credentials copied to this report.
pre_fix_normalization: max and xhigh were silently mapped to high; minimal to none.
retrospective_limit: The fingerprint proves the effort accepted by Fred. No original outbound provider HTTP body is retained; transmission is verified separately through the native Hermes transport fixture.
